name: Audio (microphone through the host's PulseAudio)
description: The audio tools a recorder in the container needs to reach the host's microphone through PulseAudio, such as Claude Code's /voice dictation: sox with its PulseAudio backend (libsox-fmt-pulse, so `rec` works), pulseaudio-utils (pactl), alsa-utils with libasound2-plugins and an ALSA default (/etc/asound.conf, only when absent or written by this Feature) that routes `default` to PulseAudio, so `arecord` works too. PULSE_SERVER is fixed at unix:/mnt/wslg/PulseServer, where the devcontainer-cli launcher mounts a relay directory on a Windows WSL2 host when the machine opts in (DCF_HOST_AUDIO=wslg in .devcontainer/.env); the microphone is OFF there until the engineer turns it on on the workstation (task audio:on, with a time limit; task audio:off ends it), and the socket is only present while it is on. Installs from the distribution's apt sources only and never fails a build: a missing package manager or a failed install is a warning. `audio-check` (task audio:check) says plainly what is missing, and "off" when the workstation has not turned audio on. Plus the Feature Taskfile.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

alsaDefault.description: Write /etc/asound.conf so ALSA's default device is PulseAudio (arecord, and any recorder that opens ALSA's default, then reach PULSE_SERVER). Never replaces an /etc/asound.conf this Feature did not write. false leaves ALSA alone.
